hooks.name: Crate Boundary & Unsafe Guard
hooks.description: preToolUse guard enforcing the two hardest-to-reverse architectural invariants before a write lands: no GUI imports in rustconn-core/rustconn-cli, and no `unsafe` outside a rustconn-*-sys crate (rustconn-pty-sys, rustconn-locale-sys, rustconn-env-sys, rustconn-dock-sys — matched by the crate-name shape, not a hardcoded list). Runs as a command (exit 2 blocks, stderr is forwarded), so a clean write costs nothing. It used to be an `agent` action, but an agent action cannot decide — every write was cancelled, acknowledged and re-issued, doubling the cost of every single edit in a session. The logic is two greps and belongs in a script. Note that both invariants are also hard compile errors (gtk4/adw/vte4 are not dependencies of the GUI-free crates, and unsafe_code = "forbid" is set workspace-wide in Cargo.toml), so this only buys a faster failure, never a missed one — hence it fails open on any internal error. (The workspace lint is `deny` rather than `forbid`: `forbid` cannot be overridden at any level, so the -sys crates could not inherit the workspace clippy set at all.)
